import type { Shape } from "./shape";
export interface Named extends Shape { name: string }
export abstract class Base implements Named {
  name = "x";
}
export class Impl extends Base {
  run(a: Shape): Named { return this.make(a); }
  private make(a: Shape): Named { return a as Named; }
}
export enum Mode { A, B }
export const mk = (): Impl => new Impl();
